question: Which of the following countries did India beat in the final to win the 2021 SAFF Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nepal** was the team that India defeated in the final to win the **2021 SAFF Championship**.
 
• The final match was held on **October 16, 2021**, at the **National Football Stadium in Malé, Maldives**.
 
• India secured a **3-0 victory** over Nepal to clinch
